solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Meat dish: second thing you see in Chinese restaurant

definitions.text: thing you see in Chinese restaurant

parts.note: a dish of chops, cuts of lamb or pork on the bone
a tick is a moment, as in 'back in a tick'

explanation.surface: A menu note: after the meat course, the next item you notice in a Chinese restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second' looks like it means the next in order; it is a TICK, a brief moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Diners in Chinese restaurants eat with a pair of thin sticks, each one a utensil you see on the table.

clue.text: Iran etc. in turmoil for sure

indicators.note: turmoil is disorder, so these letters are thrown into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A confident remark that Iran and its neighbours are definitely in upheaval.
explanation.definitionFit: Something known for sure is definite, without doubt: a synonym.

clue.text: One gathers wood for burning

indicators.note: to gather something is to take it in, so one word holds the other inside it

parts.note: taken as the word itself, spelt out
fir is a softwood timber from the conifer

explanation.surface: Someone collects firewood to make a blaze.
explanation.definitionFit: Something burning is alight, ablaze: the phrase is an idiom for being in flames.

clue.text: Wait for action on tennis court

definitions.meaning: to wait at table is to bring food to diners
the stroke that starts each point in tennis

explanation.surface: Wait for the moment play gets going on the tennis court.
explanation.definitionFit: Waiters bring dishes to guests, and a tennis player starts each point with an overhead stroke of that name.

clue.text: Wild animal beheaded? One is charged

indicators.note: with its head cut off, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: the lion is a big wild cat

explanation.surface: A beast has its head cut off, and someone faces a criminal charge for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One is charged' reads as an accused person; it is an atom carrying electric charge.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics and chemistry an atom or molecule with a net electric charge has this name.

clue.text: Was informed and could tell you the state of the game?

definitions.meaning: was aware of how matters stood, an idiom

definitions.text: could tell you the state of the game?
definitions.meaning: literally had the points tally of a match in mind

explanation.surface: A spectator who was kept up to date and could report how the match stood.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means being fully aware of the facts, and taken literally it means knowing the points tally in a match.

clue.text: Think about love as a timid person

indicators.note: around: one word goes round the other

parts.note: to muse is to ponder
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone pondering romance while being shy.
explanation.definitionFit: A quiet, nervous person is called this, after the small timid rodent.

clue.text: After meandering, limited areas came into view

indicators.note: wandering about aimlessly, so these letters drift into a new order

explanation.surface: After a winding walk, a few restricted zones appeared.
explanation.definitionFit: To appear or take physical shape is the sense, a synonym of appearing.

clue.text: Just the fellow for US!

parts.note: the man who personifies the USA, with a pun on 'us', since his initials are U and S

explanation.surface: An exclamation that someone is exactly the right man for our team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'US' is read as 'us', but it is the United States, whose national figure in top hat and stars carries those initials.
explanation.definitionFit: The figure in a starred hat is the personification of the American government.

clue.text: Sports official not totally nice, not one to get testimonial

indicators.note: not the whole word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: a referee runs games such as football

indicators.note: without, so the following letters are taken away

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A sports official who is not quite pleasant is not a person to ask for a good word.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not one' takes I out of NICE, leaving NCE.
explanation.definitionFit: A testimonial is a written recommendation from an employer, the same as a character letter.

clue.text: Some dramatic attempt backfiring, it's understood

indicators.note: going off backwards, so the letters are read in reverse
only part of the words is taken, so the letters are found inside them

explanation.surface: A theatrical effort that goes wrong, and the point is implicitly clear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks TICAT from 'dramatic attempt'; 'backfiring' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacit means implied without being stated, so something unspoken but understood.

clue.text: Green team working in harmony

indicators.note: in operation, worked into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An environmentally minded team pulls together peacefully.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in harmony means being of one mind, which is accord between people.

clue.text: He is one of them in a chemistry set

definitions.text: He is one of them in a chemistry set

parts.words: He is one of them in a chemistry set
parts.note: He is the symbol for helium, one of the substances on the periodic table

explanation.surface: A man is part of a kit of chemistry apparatus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He' looks like a man; it is the chemical symbol for helium, and the 'chemistry set' is the periodic table.
explanation.definitionFit: Helium is one of the basic substances of chemistry, each listed on the periodic table.

clue.text: Mad home — son starts to annoy nearly everyone

parts.note: being at home is being in
s is the genealogical abbreviation for son

indicators.note: the beginnings of each of the next words are taken

explanation.surface: A furious household where the boy begins irritating almost everybody.
explanation.definitionFit: Mad in the sense of crazy, out of one's mind: a synonym.

clue.text: Novelist supporting environmentalism in speech

indicators.note: spoken, so a word with the same sound is entered

parts.note: greeny is an informal word for eco-friendly or an environmentalist

explanation.surface: A writer who backs ecological causes in an address.
explanation.definitionFit: Graham Greene was an English novelist, author of Brighton Rock and The Power and the Glory.

clue.text: Looking embarrassed, volunteers given exercise in bureaucracy

parts.note: red-faced, blushing
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force
PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: Blushing recruits are put through drills in an exercise in officialdom.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive official paperwork and rules is named after the ribbon once used to tie government documents.

clue.text: Steps laid down by good person with self-importance

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint, a good person
to put on airs is to act superior

explanation.surface: Footsteps laid down by a pompous saint.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of steps between floors is a staircase: a synonym.

clue.text: Criticised innocent youngster when meeting old rocker

parts.note: a lamb is a young sheep, a byword for innocence
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth devoted to rock and roll

explanation.surface: An innocent child is attacked on meeting an aging rock musician.
explanation.definitionFit: To lambast is to scold or attack verbally, so harshly faulted.

clue.text: Horrible giants, one departing in state of anxiety

indicators.note: something horrible is in a terrible mess, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Monstrous giants, one leaving, put folk in a state of fear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one departing' removes I from GIANTS before 'Horrible' shuffles what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Angst is a German loanword for dread or deep unease, so a feeling of worry.

clue.text: Dance beat given energy

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to thrash them
go means energy or vigour, as in 'full of go'

explanation.surface: A dance rhythm is pepped up.
explanation.definitionFit: The tango is a ballroom dance from Argentina.

clue.text: Has funny new girl changed a blissful situation?

indicators.note: funny as in odd, so these letters are rearranged
altered, so these letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Has a strange new girlfriend transformed things into heaven?
explanation.walkthrough: 'funny' turns HAS into SHA; 'changed' turns GIRL A into GRILA.
explanation.definitionFit: Shangri-La is the hidden Himalayan paradise of Hilton's Lost Horizon, so any earthly paradise.

clue.text: Member in a fighting force

parts.note: RM is the Royal Marines, a British fighting force

explanation.surface: Someone belonging to a military unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member' reads as a soldier enlisted in the unit; it is a limb of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: A limb of the body, such as a leg, is a member: a synonym.

clue.text: Out-of-date permit unacceptable ultimately

parts.note: a pass is a permit to enter

indicators.note: at the end, so the last letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: An expired permit is in the end not acceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: A French loanword meaning no longer fashionable, so old hat.

clue.text: Cup of tea missed in state of confusion

indicators.note: muddled up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who skipped their cuppa is left muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: A demitasse is a small coffee cup, from the French for half-cup.
